In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cytochrome b559 of higher plants consists of two components, a low-potential component and a high-potential component.
cytochrome f is the major cytochrome in the chloroplasts and the only one with a function related to the electron transfer in the photosynthetic apparatus.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cytochrome f, b-563 and b-559LP are the major cytochromes in digitonin fraction and they have the similar properties with the cytochromes of the same type in the intact chloroplasts.
the digitonin method provides a convenient means for isolating the cytochrome f complex from chloroplasts.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the digitonin treatment of the chloroplast membranes is a useful tool to isolate the cytochromes of the photosystem II reaction center, which can be further used in the structural and functional studies of these proteins.
